name: Quote Share
description: Readers select a sentence and share it as a quote on X, Bluesky, WhatsApp or by email, or copy a link that opens your page with that sentence highlighted.

panels.title: Quote sharing
panels.description: A small bar that appears when a reader selects text in an article. Nothing loads from any network until a reader clicks, and nobody is tracked. Changes show on your pages right away.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show the share bar on selected text
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: copy
fields.title: Copy quote with link
fields.description: The link opens your page with the quoted sentence highlighted, in browsers that support it.

fields.name: language
fields.title: Language
fields.description: For the button labels screen readers hear.

fields.name: min-words
fields.title: Only on pages with at least this many words

fields.name: skip-pages
fields.title: Skip these pages
fields.description: Page addresses separated by commas, for example: home, shop/*. A * at the end means every page under it.
